summary: Remove orphaned source instances (capacity 0, DISABLED) with `awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=<node>`, repair hub content with a POST of `{"verify_checksums": true}` to `https://<gateway url>/api/galaxy/pulp/api/v3/repair/`, then fix instance group membership and update decision environments and their credentials to the new registry addresses.
questions: How do I remove old instances after AAP migration?
How do I repair automation hub content after migration?

answer_card.title: Clean up instances and repair hub
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
awx-manage list_instances
awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=node1.example.org
curl -d '{"verify_checksums": true }' -X POST -k \
  https://<gateway url>/api/galaxy/pulp/api/v3/repair/ \
  -u <gateway_admin_user>:<gateway_admin_password>
```
Then review **Instance Groups** and **Decision Environments** for old addresses.
